items.title: Fed decision, inflation, oil may drive markets in holiday-shortened week
items.description: Equity markets would remain closed on Monday for Ganesh Chaturthi

items.title: Robust demand, pricing to keep volumes strong for diagnostics sector
items.description: Brokerages expect listed diagnostics majors to maintain volume growth through FY27, helped by stable pricing, B2C demand and operating leverage

items.title: FPIs withdraw ₹13,138 crore from equities in Sep amid global uncertainty
items.description: The latest outflow comes after Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) turned net buyers in July and August, infusing ₹20,200 crore and ₹29,630 crore, respectively

items.title: Traders back Sebi's CAS revamp, favour gradual move to blended VWAP
items.description: On timings, Sebi has proposed either extending continuous trading to 3:30 pm with CAS and derivatives trading till 3:45 pm, or an earlier window ending continuous trading at 3:15 pm
